paragraphs.content: TRI - HARBOR PORT AUTHORITY Purchasing Department
REQUEST FOR PROPOSALS RFP NO. THPA 2026 -09
ISSUE DATE: OCTOBER 16, 2026 PROPOSALS DUE: NOVEMBER 24, 2026 AT 2:00 P.M. LOCAL TIME
CONTACT: HOWARD BELLAMY, CONTRACTS ADMINISTRATOR TRI- HARBOR PORT AUTHORITY, 1 TERMINAL WAY, HARBOR CITY bids@triharborport.example

1.1 The Tri-Harbor Port Authority ("Port") operates three marine terminals, 41 ship-to-shore and yard cranes, 18 berths, 2.3 million square feet of warehouse space and a fleet of 260 vehicles and pieces of mobile equipment. The Port's Maintenance Division (210 employees) currently uses a maintenance system installed in 2006 that is no longer supported.

1.2 The Port seeks proposals for a replacement maintenance management system, including software, implementation, data conversion, training and support. The resulting contract will have an initial term of five (5) years.
1.3 The Port's terminals operate 24 hours a day. Crane availability is the Division's most important performance measure; each hour of unplanned crane downtime delays vessel operations.

3.1 Deliver five (5) bound copies and one (1) electronic copy on a USB drive, in a sealed envelope marked "RFP THPA 2026-09", to the Purchasing Department, 1 Terminal Way, Harbor City. Faxed or emailed proposals will not be accepted.
3.2 PAGE LIMIT. The technical proposal shall not exceed twenty-five (25) pages, single-sided, excluding the signature page, price form and resumes. Pages in excess of the limit will not be read.
3.3 Respond to each requirement in Section 5 by number, stating "Comply", "Partially Comply" or "Do Not Comply" with an explanation.
3.4 Required attachments: (a) Signature Page; (b) Price Form; (c) three
THPA-001 The Vendor must identify any subcontractors it intends to use and the work they will perform. (M)
THPA-002 The Vendor must describe its experience delivering similar solutions to public-sector agencies. (D)
THPA-003 The Vendor must describe the size of its current customer base for the proposed solution. (M)
THPA-004 The system must provide augmented reality guidance for field technicians. (M)
THPA-005 . The system must allow users to attach photos, documents and signatures to work orders from the field. (M)
THPA-006 The system must provide automated route optimization for daily crew assignments. (M)
THPA -007 The system must record labor, parts and equipment costs at the work order level. (M)
THPA -008 The Vendor must supply forty (40) ruggedized handheld devices manufactured in the United States and rated IP68. (M)
THPA -009 The system must support all port operations. (M)
THPA -010 The system must support preventive maintenance schedules based on calendar intervals, meter readings and condition triggers. (M)
THPA-011 The system must include visual scheduling and dispatch of work to crews. (M)
THPA-012 The system must record asset condition assessments using configurable rating scales. (D)
THPA-013 The system must track total cost of ownership across the asset lifecycle. (M)
THPA-014 The system must report key performance indicators such as mean time to repair and PM compliance. (M)
THPA -015 The system must allow reports to be scheduled and distributed by email. (M)
THPA -016 The system must produce reports required by environmental regulators. (M)
THPA -017 The system must produce carbon emissions reporting aligned with the GHG Protocol. (D)
THPA-018 The system must support self-service report building by non-technical users: (M)
THPA -019 The system must exchange service order data with the CIS. (M) THPA -020 The Vendor must describe API throughput limits. (D)
THPA -021 The system must exchange data with the financial and HR system of record. (M)
THPA-022 The system must integrate with Esri ArcGIS Enterprise and ArcGIS Online. (D)
THPA-023 The system must provide a documented REST API covering all major business objects. (M)
THPA -024 The system must integrate with Microsoft 365 email, calendar and Teams. (M)
THPA-025 The system must support scheduled file-based imports and exports over secure file transfer. (M)
THPA-026 The system must provide a multilingual user interface including Spanish. (M)
THPA-027 The system must run in all major modern web browsers without plug-ins. (D)
THPA -028 The system must store all customer data in data centers located within the continental United States. (D)
THPA-029 The system must operate in a disconnected environment with no internet connectivity. . (M)
THPA-030 The Vendor must perform background checks on all personnel with access to customer data. (D)
THPA -031 The system must support multi-factor authentication for all users. (M)
THPA-032 The Vendor must describe its vulnerability scanning and patching process. (D)
THPA-033 The Vendor must sign a BAA if PHI is involved. (M)
THPA-034 . The Vendor must conduct annual disaster recovery exercises.
THPA-035 The Vendor must define the maximum acceptable data loss in a disaster. (M)
THPA-036 The system must be available 99.5% of the time, measured monthly. (M)
THPA-037 The Vendor must monitor system performance and capacity proactively. (M)
THPA-038 The Vendor must provide a dedicated single-tenant database for the agency. (M)
THPA-039 The system must use geographically separate data centers for resilience. (M)
THPA -040 The Vendor must achieve full production go-live of all modules no later than March 31, 2027. (M)
THPA -041 Implementation must not begin before January 15, 2027, and the Vendor must include a parallel run of at least twelve (12) weeks before go-live. (M)
THPA -042 The Vendor must assign a named account or customer success manager. (M)
THPA - 043 The Vendor must commit to response times for each priority level. (D)
THPA-044 The Vendor must offer support in Spanish. (M)
. THPA - 045 The Vendor must provide multiple support channels. . (M) THPA -046 The Vendor must describe how support issues are escalated, (D)
THPA-047 The Vendor must maintain commercial general liability, professional liability and cyber insurance. (M)
THPA-048 The Vendor must furnish a performance bond equal to twenty-five percent (25%) of the total contract value. (M)
THPA -049 The Vendor must indemnify the agency against third-party intellectual property infringement claims. (M)
THPA-050 The Vendor must provide a dedicated customer success contact.
The undersigned agrees to furnish the goods and services described in this proposal in accordance with RFP THPA 2026-09.
